item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Byron Donalds selects Bryan Avila as running mate in Florida governor’s race
item.description: Byron Donalds selected Miami-Dade state Sen. Bryan Avila as his running mate Tuesday, adding a Cuban-American lawmaker, educator and Florida Army National Guard captain to the GOP ticket.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on imports from the US
item.description: Canada announced retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on U.S. goods, including steel, paper and appliances, in response to Trump’s latest tariffs.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Operation Statewide Shield helps recover 163 children: AG
item.description: Attorney General James Uthmeier announced the recovery of 163 children, ranging in ages from 2 months to 17 years old, during Operation Statewide Shield.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Founders Day brings free admission to national parks nationwide
item.description: National parks nationwide will offer free admission Tuesday as the National Park Service celebrates Founders Day and marks its creation in 1916.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: How AI and student debt are reeshaping what Americans study
item.description: Student loan costs, a cooling job market, and the looming shadow of artificial intelligence are all reshaping how the next generation picks a major.
